# Extended regexes (grep -E), one per line, matched against paths changed by a
# pull request. The CLI test partitions run when any changed path matches.
#
# Derived by tracing every file a full `cargo test` in cli/ opened, at compile
# time (include_str!, build.rs) and at run time (fixtures, helm renders, and the
# `uv run` Python it shells out to, which imports the api, worker, dispatcher and
# packages sources), plus paths the sources name by relative literal. When a test
# starts reading a new file outside these paths, add it here. Pushes to main and
# next run the tests unconditionally, so a miss is caught before a release.
^cli/
^charts/
^packages/
^examples/
^apps/(api|worker|dispatcher|mail-adapter)/
^apps/ui/src/generated/commandManifest\.ts$
^adapters/
^runner/
^tests/vectors/
^compose/
^compose\.dev\.yaml$
^docs/(approvals|operations)\.md$
^\.github/workflows/
^\.github/e2e-selection\.yaml$
^\.github/rust-test-paths\.txt$
^tools/
^scripts/
^\.githooks/
^pyproject\.toml$
^uv\.lock$
^uv\.toml$
^CLAUDE\.md$
^\.gitignore$
^rust-toolchain(\.toml)?$
